category: Design Software to Meet Security Requirements and Mitigate Risks (PW)
subcategory_text: Use structured threat modelling, misuse cases, or risk analyses during design to identify and prioritise security risks and to inform the design of mitigations.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SA-11, SA-15, RA-3
implementation_examples: Conduct STRIDE-style threat modelling for each new feature or major change
Document attack-surface decisions and accepted risks
Re-run threat models after material design changes
assessment_objectives: Determine whether threat modelling is performed during design.
Determine whether identified risks are prioritised and mitigated in the design.
